scope: 59 candidate result files under evidence/ that expose a decision dict
concentration_failure_note: 20 rounds mention C2/C3/C4; most of those also fail return gates or have negative net P&L, so concentration is not the independent blocker. Only R239, R241 and R257 fail only C2/C3/C4.
return_failure_note: G4 fails in 36 of 59 rounds, G7 in 36 and G8 in 38. The dominant failure mode is negative or insufficient realized return at 3x/4x cost, not a marginal gate.
rolling_rate_note: R163 reported 67.8% rolling 1-year positive rate against a 70% gate then in force. The R261-era gate set uses a 60% threshold for G6, under which 67.8% passes.
conclusion: The gates are not uniformly too strict. The only clear threshold artifact is the earlier 70% rolling-1y gate. The concentration gates reflect a real structural property of the R257 family, confirmed by R262: take-profit and shorter holding worsen both return and concentration.
